question: In an AC generator, a coil is rotated in a uniform magnetic field. At which position of the coil is the induced emf maximum: when the plane of the coil is perpendicular to the magnetic field or parallel to it? Give reason.

options.A: When the plane of the coil is perpendicular to the field, because magnetic flux is maximum.
options.B: When the plane of the coil is perpendicular to the field, because the rate of change of flux is maximum.
options.C: When the plane of the coil is parallel to the field, because magnetic flux is maximum.
options.D: When the plane of the coil is parallel to the field, because the rate of change of magnetic flux is maximum.
